name: app-finance
description: Monorepo do app de finanças pessoais (backend + frontend)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @app-finance/backend && npm run build -w @app-finance/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @app-finance/backend && npm run typecheck -w @app-finance/frontend
